decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [Unnumbered Location Plan, A766 -L1, A766-PL01B, A766-PL02A, A766-PL03A, A766-PL05, A766-PL20, A766-PL21, A766-PL22, A766-PM03A, A766-PM04, A766-F01, Heritage Statement and Design and Access Statement, Flood Risk Matrix and A766 Photosheets. Received: 08/05/2025
A766-PL01C and A766-PL04A. Received: 13/06/2025
A766-PL04B, A766-PM01A and A766-PM02B. Received: 05/08/2025].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Condition : 4 - The basement hereby permitted shall at no time be used or occupied as a separate dwelling independent of the main house and shall not be used as sleeping accommodation.
Reason: In order to ensure that adequate living standards are maintained and to protect neighbours' living conditions.

Condition : 5 - The windows to be fitted on the rear roof face of the dwelling shall be black-framed and traditional, conservation-style.
Reason: In order to safeguard the architectural and historic interest of the conservation area and listed building.
description: Erection of conservatory and construction of a wine storage area under the floor of the conservatory, replacement of the existing pitched roof to the rear outrigger with a flat roof and extended roof terrace, erection of single storey side extension with mono-pitched roof, replacement of the existing dormer to the rear with a new dormer to match the adjoining dormer, conversion of the loft and the addition of a new staircase from the second floor, erection of bin store to the front garden, replacement guttering, RWP's and SVPs, together with internal and external alterations to the house.
